tasks.title: Setup Node.js Project with AST Parsing
tasks.description: Initialize the Node.js project structure with necessary dependencies for AST parsing and code analysis capabilities.
tasks.details:
Create a new Node.js project with the following structure:

```
/src
  /core
  /patterns
  /templates
  /validation
  /integration
/tests
/config
```

Install required dependencies:
- @babel/parser for AST generation
- @babel/traverse for AST traversal
- handlebars for template generation
- typescript and ts-node for TypeScript support

Create basic configuration files:
- tsconfig.json for TypeScript configuration
- jest.config.js for testing setup
- .eslintrc for code quality

Implement a basic AST parsing utility that can load JavaScript/TypeScript files and generate ASTs for further analysis.
tasks.testStrategy:
Write unit tests to verify:
1. Project structure is correctly initialized
2. AST parsing utility correctly parses JavaScript and TypeScript files
3. Basic traversal of ASTs works as expected
4. Configuration files are properly set up

tasks.title: Implement Anti-Pattern Detection System
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive system to detect common hardcoding anti-patterns in source code, including industry lists, location restrictions, and business type limitations.
tasks.testStrategy:
Create a comprehensive test suite with:
1. Unit tests for each individual detector with sample code snippets
2. Integration tests with small sample codebases containing known anti-patterns
3. Performance tests with larger codebases
4. False positive/negative analysis
5. Test against the example anti-patterns provided in the PRD

tasks.title: Implement Validation System
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive validation system to ensure no hardcoded limitations remain in transformed code.
tasks.details:
Develop a validation system with these components:

1. ValidationEngine class:
```typescript
class ValidationEngine {
  constructor(private detector: PatternDetectionEngine) {}
  
  async validateFile(filePath: string): Promise<ValidationResult> {}
  async validateDirectory(dirPath: string): Promise<Record<string, ValidationResult>> {}
  async validateCodebase(rootPath: string): Promise<ValidationReport> {}
}
```

2. Implement validation rules:
   - NoHardcodedIndustriesRule: Ensures no hardcoded industry lists exist
   - NoLocationLimitationsRule: Verifies no location restrictions remain
   - NoBusinessTypeRestrictionsRule: Confirms no business type limitations
   - UnlimitedScalabilityRule: Validates system can scale without limits
   - ConfigurationDrivenRule: Ensures behavior comes from user configuration

3. Create a reporting system that provides:
   - Detailed validation failures
   - Suggestions for fixing remaining issues
   - Compliance score for transformed code
   - Visual reports highlighting problem areas
tasks.testStrategy:
Test the validation system with:
1. Unit tests for each validation rule
2. Tests with intentionally non-compliant code
3. Integration tests validating transformed codebases
4. False positive/negative analysis
5. Tests against the example patterns in the PRD
6. Verification that validation catches subtle hardcoding patterns

tasks.title: Setup Qdrant Vector Database
tasks.description: Configure and deploy Qdrant vector database in a Docker container for local development with appropriate collections for documentation, code, conversations, and tasks.
tasks.details:
1. Install Docker if not already available
2. Create a docker-compose.yml file for Qdrant:
```yaml
version: '3'
services:
  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:latest
    ports:
      - "6333:6333"
      - "6334:6334"
    volumes:
      - ./qdrant_data:/qdrant/storage
```
3. Create the following collections with appropriate schemas:
   - project_docs: for documentation
   - code_snippets: for code documentation
   - chat_history: for conversation memory
   - task_context: for task tracking
4. Configure each collection with the appropriate vector dimensions (3072 for text-embedding-3-large)
5. Set up metadata filtering for file_path, content_type, timestamp, and project_context
6. Implement basic health check endpoint to verify database connectivity
7. Create initialization script to ensure collections exist on startup
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify Docker container starts successfully
2. Confirm all collections are created with correct schemas
3. Test basic vector insertion and retrieval operations
4. Benchmark query performance with sample vectors
5. Validate metadata filtering functionality
6. Test persistence across container restarts
